Subject: Hosted API quickstart & rate limit follow-up

Hi Ralph,

Great to meet you on the demo earlier — thanks for walking through Fenrir's ingestion and summarization use case. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Goal: Get a short PoC running on Redwood Hosted API so your engineering team can validate latency, cost, and output quality before deciding on Dedicated/Private.
- What we can provide this week: a 7-day hosted evaluation key with 100k tokens, a short quickstart call (30m) with a solutions engineer, and a sample config for streaming and batching.

A few quick questions so we scope the evaluation correctly: 
1) Expected steady-state throughput for the PoC (requests/sec or tokens/sec)? You had mentioned "tens of requests per second" — can you give a target QPS or concurrency number?
2) Typical request/response sizes (avg tokens in prompt / completion)?
3) Any regulatory/security constraints that would push you toward Dedicated or Private right away (e.g., data residency, on-prem requirement, customer contracts)?

Notes on rate limits and endpoints:
- Hosted API base URL: https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate
- We support streaming responses and function-like structured outputs (JSON).
- Default evaluation tier: up to 60 QPS and burst up to 120 QPS (subject to fair use). If you need sustained higher throughput we recommend Dedicated; we can tempoarily raise limits for evaluation if you share expected QPS.

I attached our quickstart guide and a one-page integration checklist. If it helps, I can provision the eval key now and we do a 30-min quickstart session tomorrow. Proposed times: Mon 10am PT or Mon 2pm PT.

Let me know the QPS target and which time works.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments:
- redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf (quickstart steps, curl examples, rate-limit notes)
- fenrir-integration-diagram.pdf (integration stub)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the follow-up and the quickstart guide — that looks helpful. Quick answers: 

- For the PoC we expect about 40–60 requests/sec, typical prompt ~120 tokens, completion ~80 tokens (we can trim later). Mainly synchronous calls but we'd like streaming for user-facing flows.
- No hard regulatory constraint for the PoC; our legal team will flag any contract-level data residency later. For pilot, Hosted API is fine.
- We have an initial performance test team of 3 engineers who will run load tests and provide sample payloads — I can share them.

Questions for you: 
- Can you confirm how rate limits map to concurrency vs QPS? If we hit the 60 QPS default, what happens? Will requests be queued or rate-limited with 429s?
- Can you create the eval key today? We can take the 10am PT slot tomorrow.

Also: can your SDKs support retry/backoff behavior in case of transient 429s? We prefer graceful retry over immediate failures.

Best,
Ralph Turner
Head of Product Engineering, Fenrir AI
ralph.turner@fenrir.ai

Hi Ralph — quick update and answers below. Looping Marissa and Neha (SE + Solutions Engineering) on the plan.

Answers to your questions: 
- Rate limiting behavior: Hosted API enforces per-key QPS limits. If you exceed the configured sustained QPS, requests will receive 429 responses. We recommend client-side exponential backoff with jitter for retries. Our SDKs (Python/Node) include built-in retry policies by default; Marissa will walk through config during the quickstart. For short bursts within the burst allowance, requests are accepted; sustained overage results in 429s.
- Eval key: Neha has provisioned a 7-day eval key for Fenrir (100k tokens) and I temporarily raised the eval tier to 80 QPS sustained with 160 QPS burst for the pilot. You should see the key in your portal and receive it by separate secure message (we don't put keys in email).

Quickstart session: confirmed Mon 10am PT. Marissa will send a calendar invite and the session link. Prep: please send the sample payloads and any target SLA expectations so we can reproduce them in our environment.

Links: 
- Quickstart doc: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstart/hosted-api
- API base: https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate

If everything looks good we can keep this as a Hosted evaluation. If you see sustained >100 QPS in load tests, we should evaluate Dedicated capacity and I can get a pricing/throughput estimate ready within 48 hours.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Aditya Rao
